info.title: AX Request Portal API
info.description: Contract the AX Request Portal frontend expects. Generated from src/api/contract.ts — do not edit by hand.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a bearer token

get.summary: User directory (names are shown on every request)

patch.summary: Change role, team or active flag (user:manage)

get.summary: Projects a request can target, with repository, wiki and owners
List requests visible to the current user

post.summary: Submit a request. The AI starts the feasibility report immediately.

get.summary: Full request with report, work run, checklist and timeline

post.summary: One-shot submission check. Issues are advisory and never block submission.
Move a request through its lifecycle (409 when the transition is not allowed)

409.description: Transition not allowed in this status

put.summary: Save QA checklist progress (requester, while in verification)
Set or change the planned release date (responsible developer)

post.summary: Upload a screenshot or file (multipart field "file", max 10 MB)

get.summary: Open regression checks on requests the developer is responsible for
Notifications for the current user, newest first
Notification channels of the current user

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM, defaults to the current month

get.summary: Planned and past releases grouped by date and project
AI spend against the monthly limit

receivedPrevMonth.description: Received in the previous month over the same span of days (month-to-date while `month` is in progress)

delayed.description: Open right now and past the desired or scheduled date

avgLeadTimeDays.description: Average days from submission to release, for requests released during `month`

onlyActionRequired.description: Only notify when it is my turn to act

PrecheckIssue.description: Shown next to the field. Never blocks submission.

ProjectTarget.description: A screen or feature a requester can pick. Normally extracted from the project wiki.

source.description: Wiki doc linked to the changed code

RequestScope.description: mine = filed by me; assigned = projects I own or requests assigned to me; all = everything (needs request:read:all)

RequestStatus.description: See src/domain/lifecycle.ts for the transition table.

Role.description: requester = planning/sales staff who file requests; executive = requester + company-wide dashboard; developer = reviews reports, runs AI work, approves merges; admin = manages projects, users and AI budget.

token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header

TransitionCommand.description: Body of POST /requests/{id}/transitions. AI and system events are not accepted from clients.

VerificationDraft.description: Saves checklist progress without changing status. Submit with confirmResult / reportIssue.

WikiTrust.description: Derived from wiki review state of the evidence documents, never from model judgement.

instructions.description: Developer memo or revision note passed to the AI

wikiChanges.description: Wiki docs edited in the same merge request; always pending human review
